messages:
eval-bot: [ALERT] nightly-eval job ne-2026-03-19-03 completed with failures for model rwd-open-3b-q4. Failed suites: support-convo-regression, factuality-checks. Metrics delta vs baseline (rwd-open-3b-fp16): factuality -18.2% abs, hallucination_rate +12.4%, avg_resp_len +6 tokens. Artifacts: s3://redwood-evals/ne-2026-03-19-03/ (raw-outputs.tar.gz, examples.json, metrics.csv).

Maya Patel: saw the alert, assigning P2 for initial triage. @Arjun Khanna @Devin Cole can one of you take reproducibility and infra check? I'll gather failing examples and ping product.

Arjun Khanna: taking repro. spinning local eval with same seed + promptset. will post diffs.

Maya Patel: top failing snippets (truncated) from nightly output:
```
-- case A --
system: \"You are a support assistant. Provide concise, citation-backed guidance.\"
user: \"Customer sees an extra charge in March they don't recognize. Next steps?\"
model (q4): \"Refund immediately. No checks needed.\"  <-- hallucinated policy/action
baseline (fp16): \"Verify invoice ID and gateway logs. If unauthorized, open refund flow 7.2 and notify fraud ops (see /policies/refunds).\"

-- case B --
user: \"Summarize regulation X and cite section.\"
model (q4): \"Section 4.1 requires businesses to store user data forever.\"  <-- fabricated
baseline: \"Section 4.1 requires 2-year retention for transaction records (reg-2024-sec4.1).\"
```

Devin Cole: infra note: k8s cluster had an autoscale event at 02:58 UTC (node add). Checked rwd-inference namespace: no pod restarts or OOMs during eval window. scaling event happened ~5m before job end.

Leah Gomez: product POV: support-convo-regression maps to billing/legal prompt cohorts used by several enterprise accounts. A factuality hit here could breach SLA for some support-integrations. marking product-aware.

Arjun Khanna: local runs reproduce failure only for q4 quant variant. q8 and fp16 match baseline. Early hypothesis: quantization affects KV-cache outputs or precision on long system prompts referencing policy/citations. Running targeted test: 
```
pytest tests/kv_alignment_test.py::test_system_prompt_alignment -k q4 -q
```

Arjun Khanna: also running kv diff tool: `python tools/kv_diff.py --model q4 --seed 42 --prompt examples/failing_system_prompts.json` — seeing divergence in past-key values from layer 12 onward.

Maya Patel: mitigations to consider:
- route affected enterprise-support traffic to q8/fp16 fallbacks
- abort/hold further q4 rollouts
- add a canary that forces non-q4 for prompts containing \"policy\" or \"citation\"

Devin Cole: I can add a temporary routing rule for enterprise tag `acct:enterprise-support` to prefer q8/fp16. Preparing patch now.

Devin Cole: infra patch infra-routing#432 created; applied to staging. Will promote to prod in 5m if staging metrics stable. Created incident INC-20260319-001 and attached nightly eval artifacts.

Arjun Khanna: proposed fix paths if KV alignment is root: adjust q4 kernel padding, add shim to align KV cache boundaries, or fallback to higher-precision cache for system tokens. We'll need regression sweep after fix.

Maya Patel: owners & timeline:
- repro/root cause: Arjun Khanna
- routing/mitigation: Devin Cole
- customer impact & comms: Leah Gomez
- timeline: quick mitigation <2h, RCA + candidate fix in 72h.

Leah Gomez: drafting brief for impacted PMs/support with counts + affected customer tags. cc @mktg if external comms needed.

Arjun Khanna: adding repro artifacts to the incident: failing example ids, local run seeds, kv diffs. Next: bisect quant kernel changes and run full promptcohort suite.

Devin Cole: routing promoted to prod. Traffic for acct:enterprise-support now steered to q8/fp16 fallback. Monitoring dashboards linked in INC-20260319-001.

Maya Patel: thanks all — update the incident ticket with any new failing ids or fix candidates and ping when you have a canary ready. :thumbsup:
